title: Asperges Me (Sprinkle Me, O Lord)
text:
Thou shalt sprinkle me with hyssop, O Lord, and I shall be cleansed.
Thou shalt wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow.

Psalm 50:3
Have mercy on me, O God, according to thy great mercy.

Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.
As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

translation.latin:
Asperges me, Domine, hyssopo, et mundabor.
Lavabis me, et super nivem dealbabor.

Miserere mei, Deus, secundum magnam misericordiam tuam.

Gloria Patri, et Filio, et Spiritui Sancto.
Sicut erat in principio, et nunc, et semper, et in saecula saeculorum. Amen.

attribution: Based on Psalm 50:9 (Psalm 51:9 in Hebrew numbering) and Psalm 50:3
notes: The Asperges Me is sung during the sprinkling of holy water before the principal Mass on Sundays outside of the Easter season. It recalls the ritual purification of the Old Testament and symbolizes our baptismal cleansing from sin. The priest sprinkles the congregation with holy water using an aspergillum.
